DeployAnalyticsRule.description: Deploy the Microsoft Sentinel analytic rules carried by this solution (ContentKind AnalyticsRule and its AnalyticsRuleTemplate registration face).

DeployPlaybook.description: Deploy the playbooks carried by this solution and the automation assets they depend on (PlaybookTemplate, AzureFunction, LogicAppsCustomConnector). These are never shipped independently of the playbook they serve.

DeployWorkbook.description: Deploy the Microsoft Sentinel workbook content and its Content Hub registration carried by this solution (ContentKind Workbook and WorkbookTemplate).

DeployDefenderWorkbook.description: Deploy Defender Workbooks and their Content Hub registrations independently of Microsoft Sentinel DeployWorkbook. Candidate provider contract requires approved lab installation, readback and update verification.

DeployDataConnector.description: Deploy the data connectors carried by this solution, together with their metadata and catalog entries (ContentKind DataConnector, ResourceDataConnector and DataType).

DeployCustomDetection.description: Deploy the XDR-native custom detection resources and their Content Hub registrations (ContentKind CustomDetection and CustomDetectionTemplate). Independent of DeployAnalyticsRule: both kinds can be selected together. Existing analytic-rule instances are not disabled or removed. CD enabled or disabled status is controlled separately from this deployment switch.

DeployHuntingQuery.description: Deploy the Microsoft Sentinel hunting queries carried by this solution.

DeployInvestigationQuery.description: Deploy the Microsoft Sentinel investigation queries carried by this solution.

DeployParser.description: Deploy the parsers and their registrations carried by this solution.

DeployWatchlist.description: Deploy the watchlists and their registrations carried by this solution.

DeployNotebook.description: Deploy the notebooks carried by this solution.

DeployAutomationRule.description: Deploy the Microsoft Sentinel automation rules carried by this solution.

DeploySummaryRule.description: Deploy the summary rules and their registrations carried by this solution.
